memory_accumulation_diagnostic.name: ced_shared_memory_read_high_precision_v1
memory_accumulation_diagnostic.scope: ReadBlock attention over the shared encoder-final K/V bank only; SelfBlock unchanged

G3_G5.reason: Freeze data group splits, recovery/token/search budgets, endpoints, margins and resource envelopes after informative G0 and before training. No results-based choices.

G1_QUALITY.rationale: Every other stage is satisfied by a model that emits token salad: they check tensor accounting, save/reload, parameter counts and cache-order parity, all of which are plumbing or self-consistency properties. This stage compares an arm to the frozen source on already-open splits.
G1_QUALITY.threshold_provenance: Chosen on principle, not tuned to any measured arm. CE and KL bound divergence from the frozen teacher at roughly half a nat and one nat; the top-1 floor is chance-vs-majority; termination reuses the existing G0 min_termination_rate of 0.8; the nondegeneracy rule requires a quarter of prompts to produce distinct answers. HOTFIX-004 corrects an overstatement in HOTFIX-003: D40 sits at 0.5032 against the 0.5000 top-1 floor, so that individual check IS threshold-sensitive. Its overall verdict is not, because KL and termination both fail it independently. The top-1 floor was deliberately NOT moved after seeing that number: tuning a threshold on a measured outcome is forbidden.

G1_RETENTION.rationale: G1_QUALITY closed the token-salad hole at initialization, but every check it applies is likelihood- or teacher-agreement-shaped, and those are now measured to decouple from capability. At a token-matched 500,099-target dose a CED arm reached held-out CE 0.4727 against the frozen source's 5.5782 -- 5.1055 nats BETTER than its own teacher -- while answering 2 of 60 held-out questions the source answers 20 of 60, with disjoint 95% intervals. Of the eight non-task signals the run records, seven admit no separating threshold and four invert; the eighth, top-1 agreement with the source, separates by only 0.0038 (0.32798 vs 0.32416) against a registered G1_QUALITY floor of 0.5 that both arms fail, and it is still closing. So none supports a defensible registered threshold. This stage scores answers instead. Corrected after SIGNAL_SEPARATION.json falsified the stronger claim originally written here, which was that no likelihood-shaped quantity separates the two models at all -- the same shape of overstatement HOTFIX-004 had to retract from HOTFIX-003.
G1_RETENTION.threshold_provenance: Transcribed unchanged from RETENTION_GATE_DESIGN.md, committed at f7bc290 before this code existed and before any arm was scored under the typed grammar. The rules are policy tolerances, not values fitted to an arm. max_correct_to_incorrect_per_class is 0 because a gate that permits any forgetting has to justify the permitted amount, and no measurement here supports a number; min_termination_rate_per_class REUSES the existing G0.min_termination_rate of 0.8 rather than inventing a value; min_source_correct_terminated_per_class is 1, the weakest statement that rules out the arithmetic_chain failure where the teacher scores 0 and the probe measures nothing. Historical arm scores under the LEGACY number-sequence scorer were already known when these rules were written, so applying them to an already-measured arm is retrospective demonstration, never preregistered validation. Source scores under this grammar were not known.
G1_RETENTION.excluded_probe_class_reason: the frozen source scores 0/20, so every arm would read 0/N before and after and the probe would measure nothing
G1_RETENTION.confirmation_min_retention_is_inert: The separately designed confirmation certificate pairs an exact binomial bound of 0.10 with a 9/10 retention floor. The floor can never bind: for alpha=1/180 the Clopper-Pearson upper limit always exceeds k/m, so bound<=0.10 already implies retention>0.9 (verified exhaustively for m<=600). Worse, at the registered minimum m=50 only ZERO losses clear the bound -- one loss does not clear it until m=70 -- so the certificate demands 100% retention at its own minimum panel size, not 90%. Recorded, not silently repaired: the confirmation lane is not implemented or licensed.
G1_RETENTION.declared_calibration_family_overlap_note: Two of the 150 probe families also appear in the open calibration split, which G1_WIDTH uses for activation statistics. Disclosed rather than gated: the count is a fixed property of committed data, known before any arm was scored, and the receipt fails if the observed overlap stops matching it. The probe is fully family-disjoint and id-disjoint from the training splits, which is the exposure that would matter during training.
